# Squincky

> AI financial document assistant that turns invoices, receipts, and bank statements into clean, structured Excel or CSV data.

Squincky is a drag-and-drop web tool for founders, freelancers, and finance teams. Upload any invoice, receipt, or bank statement (PDF or image) and get back a spreadsheet with date, amount, merchant, category, and description for every transaction.

## Pages
- [Home / Uploader](/): Drag and drop an invoice, receipt, or bank statement to convert it into Excel or CSV.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in to save conversion history and manage subscription.
